name: Inverter
description: The simplest logic gate. The last level's channel, its drain now fed from 25 through a load resistor: while the channel is off, almost no current flows and the drain sits near 25 (a logical 1); while it conducts, the current through the load pulls the drain down (a 0). The gate starts at -60, off; at $t = 100$ a pulse brings it to your supply's level, for 100. Make the drain sit between 22.5 and 25.5 while the gate is off (averaged over $t = 60$ to $100$) and between 15 and 19 while it conducts ($t = 160$ to $200$). Watch the drain jump as the gate switches: the gate pushes charge onto it through the capacitance between them.

reality.represents: A resistor-load inverter: the simplest logic gate

remarks.line: Logic levels from a load line
remarks.detail: Off, the channel passes almost nothing and the drain sits near the supply (a 1); on, its current through the load pulls the drain down (a 0).
At each switch the gate's step jumps the drain for a moment through the capacitance between them, as in real logic.

A depletion transistor conducts at 0, so the gate must go to −60 to switch it off; real logic uses enhancement-mode transistors, off at 0, in complementary pairs (CMOS) that draw no current when idle.

Only electrons: no holes, no generation or recombination. A MOSFET's inversion layer and the pn junctions at its source and drain cannot form, so this is a uniformly doped, normally-on channel that the gate depletes: a junctionless (depletion-mode) transistor, not an enhancement-mode MOSFET.

The gate faces the channel across empty space, and the permittivity is 1 everywhere (silicon's is 11.7, its oxide's 3.9). No work-function difference (gate 0 is flat band), no oxide or interface charge, no traps, no gate leakage.

remarks.line: A slice of an infinitely wide device
remarks.detail: The device is infinitely wide along z (the usual cut in device simulation), but each carrier is a line of charge moving as one: its noise and grainy field are far larger than a real device's, why the current deep below threshold is not converged.

electrodes.label: gate, above the channel (the pulse; its top your supply)
